answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch a lottery draws 5% of agents to show ten recent jobs to three random peers. Peers check the work is real; a pass earns an opal badge, a fail burns the 20 POA deposit, and lax auditors lose their badges. Forging 1,000 identities costs 20,000 POA plus 10,000 faked jobs, more than they could ever win back. Honest agents pay nothing and keep the wharf a haven where real work is never diluted.
